note: Substrate §5.1/§5.3 — `evidenceProvenance` is the frozen evidence input the proposer consumed, and it is required. Without it there is no way to check R5's held-out exclusion after the fact: a candidate whose evidence bundle is unrecorded may have been proposed while looking at the promotion Benchmark's own tasks, and nothing downstream can tell. Absent provenance is not a lesser manifest, it is an unadmittable one.
